title: Summer Intern — Software / Blockchain Development
description: Worked at C3iHub, IIT Kanpur's National Cybersecurity Reference Framework, gaining hands-on experience in blockchain engineering and smart contract development.
responsibilities: Learned core blockchain concepts: blocks, hashing, smart contracts, consensus mechanisms, and decentralized architecture.
Developed and tested smart contracts using Solidity for real-world use cases such as voting and secure data storage.
Integrated blockchain logic with backend services using Web3.py for transaction handling and data retrieval.
Contributed to a blockchain-based e-voting system, focusing on transparency, immutability, and secure vote casting.
